{{Quote|That scream&hellip; What is it? It sounds like&hellip; a man being eaten alive!|[[Nomi Sunrider]], hearing Exar Kun's anguish through the Force|<ref name="DLOTSA">[[Tales of the Jedi: Dark Lords of the Sith (audio drama)|''Tales of the Jedi: Dark Lords of the Sith'' audio drama]]</ref>}}
A '''Force scream''' was usually an involuntary [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Force power/Legends|exertion]] manifested by [[Darksider|those]] whose alignment was with the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] but could be used on command. It was a scream, of strong frustration, rage, or grief, emitted through the Force.

==Description==
{{Quote|Nooooooooooooooo!|Darth Vader, upon learning of [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala's]] death|<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref>}}
[[File:UlicForceScream.jpg|thumb|left|180px|[[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]] screaming through the Force]]
If a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] or [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] was being beaten and frustrated by his foe, he might let out an enraged scream (amplified through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]) that triggered shock waves that rippled through the Force. This caused devastation to any that were unfortunate enough to be in proximity. Like many [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] Force powers, it allowed the user to use powerful negative emotions as a weapon, albeit involuntarily in this case.

The Force scream had been called "a wave of hatred, amplified and fueled by the dark side, that is capable of smashing through mental and physical defenses with ease." A number of references to Dark Jedi in [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] archives often mentioned the Dark Jedi violently losing control in the final moments of battle.

==Notable uses==
{{Quote|And C'baoth went berserk.|[[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] describing [[Joruus C'baoth]]'s Force scream|<ref name="The Last Command">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref>}}
After being told that the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] was the only means to save himself in the ruins of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] temple on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] by the ancient Sith Lord [[Freedon Nadd]], [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]] let out an enormous scream through the Force. Such was the power of his scream that [[Jedi Master/Legends|Masters]] [[Vodo-Siosk Baas]] and [[Arca Jeth]] both heard and felt Kun's anguish many [[Light-year/Legends|light-years]] away while on the planet [[Deneba/Legends|Deneba]].<ref name="DLOTS">''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith]]''</ref><ref name="DLOTSA" />

[[File:AnakinForceScream-Chapter19.jpg|thumb|right|200px|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] rage]]
Freedon Nadd himself let out a powerful scream through the Force, after dying a second death at the hands of his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|pupil]] Exar Kun. Kun also released a scream through the Force at that moment, in triumph over Nadd and after giving himself over fully to the dark side. [[Nomi Sunrider]] and Master Vodo Baas heard both screams through the Force, and [[Nomi Sunrider|Nomi]] mistakenly thought that Exar's scream was that of Ulic Qel-Droma. Master Vodo knew better, however, realizing the voice of his former student. He felt the disturbance in the Force, noting that it felt as if one great power had fallen and another had risen in its place.<ref name="DLOTS" /><ref name="DLOTSA" />

[[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]], having been subjected to [[Krath/Legends|Krath]] leader [[Satal Keto/Legends|Satal Keto's]] torture droid, refused to reveal the truth behind his coming to [[Empress Teta/Legends|Empress Teta]]. But when Satal injected him with [[Sith poison]], a powerful toxin that amplified an individual's rage and opened them further to the dark side, Ulic let out a scream through the Force so strong that it obliterated the machinery he was harnessed to, as well as the torture droid. Later, after he [[Duel in the Iron Citadel (Satal Keto)|dueled]] and killed Satal, he let out a Force scream that wrecked the [[Iron Citadel/Legends|Iron Citadel]] balcony and knocked both [[Nomi Sunrider]] and his brother [[Cay Qel-Droma|Cay]] from their feet.<ref name="DLOTS" /><ref name="DLOTSA" />

[[Darth Malak]], [[Kreia|Darth Traya]], and [[Darth Nihilus]] were known to use Force scream.<ref name="KOTOR CG">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> [[3660 BBY|Three centuries later]], during the [[Battle of Ord Radama]], [[Darth Malgus]] let out a Force scream after [[Force sense/Legends|sensing]] the deaths of [[Darth Venemal]] and the crew of a [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]]. In the process, the scream not only made the ''[[Lindworm]]''{{'s}} bridge shake and its crew's ears bleed, but also overload the fuel cells of nearby [[Aurek-class tactical strikefighter|''Aurek''-class starfighters]].<ref name="Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref> [[Darth Baras]] also let out a scream after some failed attempts to get information of a captured Republic [[Republic Strategic Information Service|spy]] named [[Grik Sonosan]], shaking the walls of his office in the [[Imperial Citadel (Sith Empire)|Imperial Citadel]].<ref name="Laying Waste">{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Warrior|Laying Waste|Dromund Kaas}}</ref>

[[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], after accidentally cutting himself, nearly used a Force scream that would've collapsed the walls of the [[Orsis Academy]].<ref name="Restraint">{{StoryCite|story=Restraint|book=Darth Maul: Shadow Hunter}}</ref> However, he released a scream outdoors on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] shortly after regaining his memory. Later, while [[Skirmish above Raydonia/Legends|dueling]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] on the [[Turtle Tanker/Legends|Turtle Tanker]] above [[Raydonia/Legends|Raydonia]], Maul let out a feral roar of anger as he and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] tried to give chase to the escaping Ventress and Kenobi.<ref name="Revenge episode">{{TCW|Revenge (episode)}}</ref>
[[File:Vader-forcescream.png|thumb|left|250px|Darth Vader, screaming through the Force upon learning of [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|his wife's]] death]]
Right after being [[Shiak|impaled]] by Asajj Ventress, [[Darrus Jeht/Legends|Darrus Jeht]] had unleashed a [[Force storm (weather)|Force storm]] on her, his anger-filled scream seemingly adding thunder to the phenomenon.<ref name="Dark Heart">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20050616darkheart|text=Dark Heart|int=Dark Heart (short story)}}</ref>

After [[Duel on Yavin 4|defeating]] Asajj Ventress on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] released his rage while standing on the precipice where Ventress seemingly fell to her death, and let out a powerful scream through the Force.<ref name="Clone Wars Chapter 19">{{CW|19}}</ref> He also howled [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] name during the [[recapture of Tythe]]; the magnitude and wrath of the scream caused the building's entire roof to collapse, incapacitating himself and his former master, Obi-Wan Kenobi, as well as Dooku. The Sith Lord was awed and shocked by this display and tried to comfort himself by rationalizing that the building was already about to fall.<ref name="Labyrinth of Evil">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref>

By far, Skywalker's most infamous use of it was upon learning of the death of his wife, [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], after his transformation into Darth Vader. This caused him to involuntarily unleash a powerful Force scream of shame, rage, and grief, severely damaging the medical chamber and the droids within it.<ref name="ROTS" /> The scream did not stop there, however. It echoed throughout the [[Emperor Palpatine Surgical Reconstruction Center|whole facility]], causing the sensors to go haywire and one medical worker to permanently lose his hearing. Many staff members believed this scream came from a ghost, carrying out the death cries of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Against the Empire">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Against the Empire]]''</ref> A month later, upon reflecting the consequences of his fall, Vader let loose a moan that caused plinths in the ruins of the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]] to collapse.<ref name="TRoDV">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref>

[[File:CbaothForceScream_TLC6.jpg|thumb|right|160px|Joruus C'baoth emits screams during his face-off with Luke Skywalker and Mara Jade]]
During his brief apprenticeship under [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], [[Ferus Olin]] recalled the image in which he witnessed his friend [[Roan Lands]] die at Darth Vader's [[Darth Vader's lightsaber/Legends|blade]]. Thus, he let loose a scream in which he dislodged a brace from an exercise bar in a training room.<ref name="Against the Empire" />

On [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]], upon witnessing [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] slay the [[Luuke Skywalker|clone]] he had painstakingly bred from [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Joruus C'baoth]] became so furious that he caused the ceiling of the [[Mount Tantiss/Legends|Mount Tantiss]] storehouse throne room to collapse through the power of his scream while battling Skywalker and Jade.<ref name="The Last Command" /> Almost immediately afterwards, he put up a [[Force barrier]] to keep the stones from hitting him.<ref name="The Last Command 6">[[The Last Command 6|''The Last Command'' 6]]</ref>

While held captive in the [[Shadow Academy]], [[Lowbacca]] suffered physical and psychological [[Torture/Legends|torture]] under [[Tamith Kai]], which would not stop until he had destroyed the [[Sonic generator/Legends|sonic generator]]. After she showed them [[Hologram/Legends|holographic images]] of [[Darth Caedus|Jacen]] and [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] seemingly enjoying their training, Lowbacca felt so betrayed that he unleashed what could be described a "howl of rage" before slipping into unconscious. He awoke to find the sonic generator utterly wrecked, just as Tamith Kai wanted.<ref name="Shadow Academy">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Shadow Academy]]''</ref>

Darth Caedus used a telepathic variant of the Force scream to warn his lover, [[Queen Mother]] [[Tenel Ka Djo]], and [[Allana Djo Solo|their daughter]] about a [[nanovirus]] that was about to be released aboard [[Dragon Queen|their ship]] during [[Battle of Uroro Station|his final clash]] with [his twin sister. Jaina killed him before he could finish his message, but Djo heard him and escaped the nanovirus with Allana, though many of her cousins were slaughtered by it.<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Invincible">''[[Legacy of the Force: Invincible]]''</ref>
